listSubtitle: Persistent, path-addressed memory that sessions mount and read/write. Entries are versioned and retained for 30 days.
listNameConflict: A memory store named "{{name}}" already exists.
listEmpty: No memory stores yet. Create one to give agents persistent memory.
detailDeleteConflict: Cannot delete: a running session still has this store mounted. Terminate the session first, or archive the store instead.
detailNoVersionsForMemory: No versions recorded for this memory.
detailContentRedacted: Content has been redacted and is no longer available.
detailPreconditionFailed: Precondition failed — the memory changed since it was loaded. Reload and try again.
detailMemoriesEmpty: No memories yet. Entries appear here when written by sessions or via the API.
detailRedactDescription: Permanently zero this version's bytes for compliance (e.g. GDPR). If it is the current head, a redaction marker version is written and the memory is removed from the store view. This cannot be undone.
detailArchiveConfirmMessage: Archive "{{name}}"? Archived stores cannot be mounted by new sessions but remain reachable for forensics.
detailDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and all its memories and versions? This fails while a running session still has the store mounted.
detailDeleteMemoryMessage: Soft-delete memory "{{path}}"? A delete version is written so the history stays intact within the retention window.
